title: THE HAND-CART EMIGRATION--PERISHING IN THE SNOW--HEROIC CONDUCT OF
author: Orson F. Whitney
note: Published 1888. Whitney (grandson, later apostle). 68 chapters. Incorporates extensive verbatim journal extracts.

footnotes.text: General A. S. Johnston, who led this army to Utah, fell at the battle of Shiloh, April 6th, 1862, fighting on the side of the Confederacy. He was a brave and brilliant soldier, and one of the recognized great generals of the war.
